messages:
amanda: Quick check — trying to wrap up AWS/GCP/Azure sandbox access and entitlement wiring for the marketplace listing. We still don't have test SKUs wired for trials on GCP and Azure. Need a quick plan for creds + role mapping so QA can smoke the purchase flow tomorrow.
li: I can provision service accounts tonight. For GCP I'll add a publisher-sa with roles: roles/compute.viewer + roles/storage.objectViewer and grant Pub Console access. For Azure need a SPN and role assignment on subscription.
jon: Packaging note: make sure the trial SKU in the product manifest matches the entitlement ID in billing. Last time they diverged. I can update the manifest if you drop the entitlement mapping here.
amanda: thanks — entitlement IDs we intend to use: AWS trial ent: ent-aws-022, GCP: ent-gcp-07, Azure: ent-az-09. Jon can you map those to the manifest?
jon: yep, will patch manifest today. Also reminders for docs: trial duration 14 days, seats 5 by default.
maria: FYI legal needs the localized EULA link and a confirmation that telemetry is disabled by default in sandbox images. Can you confirm that before we go to staging?
li: Telemetry is off for sandbox images. I'll paste the terraform snippet for SA binding:
```
resource "google_service_account" "publisher_sa" {
  account_id   = "redwood-pub-sa"
  display_name = "Marketplace publisher SA"
}
resource "google_project_iam_member" "pub_viewer" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/storage.objectViewer"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.publisher_sa.email}"
}
```
amanda: perfect. For Azure SPN I'll need the tenant + sub IDs from infra. @li can you create and drop creds into the secure channel when ready?
li: yep will create SPN and upload to secrets-manager; leaving a comment here when done.
marketplace-bot: Ticket #PM-4287 created: sandbox-entitlement-wiring — assignees: li, jon — due: 2024-08-21. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-4287
amanda: great. Maria, can you confirm legal signoff window?
maria: aiming to review by EOD. If we get the telemetry confirmation and EULA link I'll mark as approved.
jon: manifest PR up in 30m, will tag amanda and li for quick review.
amanda: thanks all — syncing after PR merge. :thumbsup:
